[LSER.10.4] **`t.dwell` is independent of series.** Compile-
time alias for the time since the fact entered working memory
([LEXP.9.5.1]) on `logical`-schema bindings, not a maintained
statistic. See [LFAC].
Restates [LSER.8.2.1].

`dwell` is a reserved word ([LLEX.9.5]) and carries a row on
[LLEX.9.6]. Being an alias rather than an aggregation changes
what it computes, not whether an author may name a slot after
it: the companion read is syntactically identical to a slot
read, so the two occupy one position and one must yield.
